title: matchPartial dispatches a listed nominal case and sends every unlisted failure to the explicit fallback
notes: docs/DECISIONS.md 'Typed failures' (Locked) lists matchPartial among the compiler-aware Error.prototype methods, and specification/failures.mdx, 'Error Prototype', requires the same set. The negative half of the rule — that the fallback cannot be omitted — is 04-nominal-errors/error-match-partial-needs-a-fallback; this case pins the positive half, including that the listed handler receives its argument narrowed to NotFound (it reads `failure.key`).
